Because after `git commit -qm 'add HEAD file'`, the merge completed and MERGE_HEAD no longer exists. My repro moved past the merge. That's why MERGE_HEAD bad. The HEAD ambiguity was the original error before commit. Let me redo without committing, but with a tracked HEAD file. But I can't add a tracked HEAD file without committing... Actually in the original test, the collision is "tracked FILE whose name collides". Tracked means committed. In a merge conflict state, can you have a tracked file named HEAD? Yes, if it existed before the merge on both branches. Let me build a better scenario: create a file named HEAD and commit it on both branches before the merge.
